---
description: "Use when writing or reviewing Markdown documentation, specifications, examples, and project instructions."
applyTo: ["README.md", "SPEC.md", "docs/**/*.md"]
---
# Documentation

- Keep requirements, implementation status and commands accurate; distinguish planned behavior from shipped behavior. Resolve contradictions with existing requirements before changing meaning.
- Use language-tagged code fences and relative links. Keep examples copyable; do not include secrets or personal data.
- Update directly related setup, API, operational and test documentation with behavior changes. Validate executable examples or state when they were not run.
